With 500,000 - 800,000 readers each month, Tokyo Cheapo is the site of choice for value hunters who want their yen to go further in Tokyo. We cover all the basics including things to do in Tokyo ,
how to get from Narita airport to Tokyo , which JR rail pass to choose , getting a SIM card and pocket wifi .
To find why we started this site, check out the Tokyo Cheapo Manifesto . For more about the people behind this site, check out the profiles of the cheapos . If you want to contribute, see our careers page . For advertising and sponsorship of our Tokyo Cheapo channels, get in touch here .
